name: Work Orders - Execution Engine
description: Work order lifecycle: generation from cycle.due events, acknowledge/reject/snooze, item execution, measurements, signatures, comments.

core.ModuleBase: Implemented with name, version, dependencies, profiles
core.event_bus: Subscribes to cycle.due/cycle.missed, publishes work_order.* events
core.logger: Structured JSON logging with module namespacing
core.utils: utcnow(), new_id() for timestamps and IDs

db.org_scoped_session: All queries filtered by organization_id with RLS

api.RequestContext: Extracts org_id, user_id, role from claims

auth.require_roles: MANAGER/SYS_ADMIN for write operations, MAINTENANCE for item updates

templates.snapshot: Template snapshot for WO item generation

assets.for_node: Target asset info for WO title
assets.effective_flags: Safety flags displayed in WO detail
assets.set_safety_flag: FLAG_CRITICAL_STOP triggers safety flag on overdue

files.attach: Link files to WO or items

key_features.snapshot_isolation: Cycle/template changes apply only to NEW work orders, existing WOs keep frozen snapshots
key_features.predecessor_logic: PENDING_PREDECESSOR status releases when predecessor completes
key_features.completion_derivation: Percentage computed from item terminal states
key_features.deadline_behavior: FLAG_CRITICAL_STOP triggers ASSETS safety flag; WAIT_UNTIL_COMPLETED marks wait
key_features.role_filtering: MAINTENANCE sees assigned/pool, MANAGER sees all org WOs

restrictions: WORKORDERS never calls CYCLES directly - subscribes to cycle.due/cycle.missed events only
Changes to cycles/templates apply only to newly generated work orders
Snooze duration must be exact set value
Only MANAGER/SYS_ADMIN can close work orders
Signature only required when snapshot item requires it
STOP_UNTIL_COMPLETE safety flag released only on successful completion
recommendations: Implement full SQLAlchemy ORM models with proper relationships
Add telemetry/metrics for WO completion time, rejection rates
Implement WoNodeView port for QR resolve and MCP resources
Add bulk operations for batch WO acknowledgments
Consider adding WO templates for common maintenance scenarios
Implement WO priority escalation based on overdue duration
Add search/filter capabilities for WO list (by asset, date range, assignee)
notes: Module follows DDD patterns established in previous chunks
Event-driven architecture: WORKORDERS subscribes to cycle.due, emits work_order.* events
Idempotency ensures no duplicate work orders even with concurrent cycle evaluations
Placeholder DB operations ready for SQLAlchemy model integration
All API routes properly secured with RBAC guards
Beat schedules registered for snooze resume and overdue flagging
State machine enforces valid transitions, raises InvalidTransitionError on violations

dependencies_chain.chunk_1: core (ModuleBase, event bus, registry, logger, utils)
dependencies_chain.chunk_3: api (Router, RequestContext, pagination), worker (tasks, beat schedules)
